content:
sam: FYI seeing a short but sharp invoice delta blip correlated with yesterday's api-gateway change that expanded client-side batch requests into subrequests.

irene: Link to the alert: https://console.redwood.internal/alerts/invoice-delta?since=24h

sam: Symptoms: preview shows +$1.3k for a handful of tenants around 02:10 UTC; raw metering stream shows duplicated token events when batch_expansion=true.

raghav: Which component does the expansion now? gateway v2?

sam: Yes, gateway v2 added on-the-fly decomposition (PR #4021). It turns one batch POST into N internal requests (one per item) and sets header X-Client-Batch-Id.

maria: sample ingress snippets from the trace: 
```
INGRESS id=xyz1 tenant=beta tokens=1200 fingerprint=fp-A emit=true batch_id=b-123 subindex=0
INGRESS id=xyz2 tenant=beta tokens=1200 fingerprint=fp-A emit=true batch_id=b-123 subindex=1
```

sam: The problem: ledger-aggregator had an old dedupe key (request_fingerprint) that matched the original batch but, after expansion, route_resolver assigns different route_ids to subrequests (route enrichment adds route_tag=sub-sim). Aggregator sees them as distinct billable events and double-counts tokens when both batch-level and subrequest-level events are emitted.

billing-bot: billing_event_emit rate spiked from 12/s -> 240/s for route=sub-sim for tenant=beta :rotating_light: 

eng-sre: Could be a timing/race too: the gateway emits a batch-summary event then the expanded subrequests emit their own events. We should look for both summary and expanded events in the same trace.

irene: Found traces where we emitted summary_event=true and also N subrequest events within 200ms. Example: 
```
TRACE t=2026-03-21T02:10:12Z trace_id=trc-77 summary_emitted=true
subreqs_emitted=3
```

raghav: Two ways we can approach:
- short term: stop emitting batch-summary events to metering when expansion is enabled
- medium: change aggregator dedupe key to include X-Client-Batch-Id OR prefer batch-summary over subrequests
- long term: make route enrichment idempotent so subrequests inherit route_id from batch if batch_id present

maria: I worry about changing dedupe rules blindly. Some workflows intentionally emit both summary and detail for separate billing semantics. We need a route-level config flag that indicates "batch-handles-billing".

devex: UX/Console ask: can we add a small rollout telemetry card that shows "batch expanded" vs "batch summary only" counts per tenant? Would have surfaced this during the gateway canary.

eng-sre: Quick mitigation: gate gateway v2 expansion by tenant feature-flag off for high-value tenants until we land aggregator change.

sam: Agreed. I'm toggling expansion=false for tenants [beta, gamma, delta] now.

billing-bot: scheduled backfill for duplicated events queued (job 7789). Note: backfill will dedupe by batch_id when present.

irene: Action items:
- raghav: implement aggregator support for X-Client-Batch-Id (prefers summary if present) — target patch in 48h.
- devex: add console telemetry card for batch-expansion vs summary counts — small card in routing dashboard.
- eng-sre: add canary test that simulates batch expansion + summary emission to assert no net delta.
- sam: temporary feature-flag toggles for affected tenants and publish rollback timeline.

maria: Also add a billing contract note: "gateway should not emit both summary and detail unless explicitly configured".

sam: Will write a short postmortem once root cause confirmed. For now feature-flagged expansion off and backfill in progress.

billing-bot: backfill-job-7789 started. ETA ~2h.

devex: small UX TODO: add tooltip on preview that explains batching semantics (summary vs per-item) to help customers interpret spikes.

eng-sre: monitoring rule added: if billing_event_rate for a tenant jumps >10x while batch_expansion toggled true, auto-disable expansion and page oncall.

sam: Thanks all — keeping this channel updated as backfill runs and patch lands.
